title: Forecasting Bond Yields with SARIMAX
analytical_question: Do inflation, policy rates, and global risk improve a bond yield forecast?
learning_objectives: Connect statistical fit with country-risk judgement

concepts.name: SARIMAX
concepts.plain_english: SARIMAX extends ARIMA by adding seasonal patterns and external explanatory variables.

concepts.name: External regressor
concepts.plain_english: An external regressor is another variable that may help explain or forecast the target variable.

review_questions: Do the external variables have a sensible economic role?
Could future values of external variables be known in practice?
Does better AIC translate into a better analyst story?
